style_definition.style_purpose: A reusable house illustration style for The Poblysh Journal's mobile-first latazin essays, designed to express strategic thought, institutional seriousness, and editorial calm through minimal, symbolic illustration.

visual_identity.visual_category: Light-toned conceptual editorial illustration with a restrained monochrome base and washed accent color

rendering_technique: Minimal spatial depth with diagrammatic clarity
Low-noise composition with tactile surface character
constant_style_rules.surface_signature: Refined graphite-paper texture with fine pencil grain, subtle print-like noise, dry tonal softness, lifted paper-lit values, and restrained analog imperfection; tactile and editorial, never glossy or ultra-smooth.

composition.grid_compatibility: Designed to sit comfortably within a 3-column by 4-row latazin grid
composition.negative_space: 40-60% calm open area when used for covers, bridge pages, and statement-adjacent image pages

typography_context.usage_note: Typography should be overlaid in layout rather than rendered inside the image. Preserve negative space for title, supporting line, statement, or short bridge text.

color_system.accent_usage_rule: Use one or two accent colors in every illustration, together occupying roughly 5-10% of the image, typically as faint reflections, edge tint, soft atmospheric fields, window light, or subtle material temperature. The support colors should keep the image alive, not disappear.
color_system.default_accent_behavior: If no accent choice is supplied, default to mist_blue plus warm_parchment, or a single very soft warm_parchment cast when the scene needs more quiet.
color_system.black_usage_rule: Use true black sparingly for threshold, divider, or residue-like visual intensity.

tonal_balance: Bias the image toward paper white, bone, and soft ash as the dominant value field
Avoid crushed blacks and low-key gloom
Preserve air, light, and readable contrast
light_behavior: Daylit or softly lit interior light by default
No noir darkness unless explicitly requested
texture_behavior: Fine dry pencil texture integrated into tonal areas
Subtle paper tooth and print-like grain
Soft mottled surface rather than smooth digital polish

preferred_visual_motifs: Signals rendered as subtle paths or traces
forbidden_elements: Photographic sharpness as the dominant feel

cover_threshold.composition_bias: Maximum negative space, minimal subject count, stronger architectural or symbolic calm
cover_threshold.mood_bias: Most restrained and premium, but still paper-lit and breathable

image_only.composition_bias: Atmospheric or symbolic, can be slightly fuller but still uncluttered

bridge_page.composition_bias: Clear visual hinge with one dominant subject zone and one quiet zone for short text

detail_study.composition_bias: Tight crop on one object, material, edge, reflection, or gesture

closing_residue.composition_bias: Extremely sparse, soft tonal field or one quiet symbolic subject

variable_inputs.subject_or_object: The main object, scene, figure, or symbolic subject to be illustrated
variable_inputs.conceptual_intent: The strategic or emotional idea the image should support, such as legibility, timing, hidden progress, trust, threshold, or private movement
variable_inputs.scene_type: Optional narrowing of setting, such as corridor, lobby, tabletop still life, archive shelf, window, doorway, or abstract tone field
variable_inputs.page_role: Optional page function such as cover_threshold, image_only, bridge_page, detail_study, or closing_residue
variable_inputs.accent_choice: Preferred choice of one or two accents from mist_blue, blush_paper, warm_parchment; if omitted, the default accent behavior still applies
variable_inputs.presence_of_human_fragment: Optional boolean or description indicating whether a restrained human fragment should appear
variable_inputs.extra_notes: Optional special compositional or symbolic instruction

prompt_assembly_template.template_base: Editorial illustration in the Poblysh Journal house style. Subject: {subject_or_object}. Conceptual intent: {conceptual_intent}. Render as a light-toned conceptual editorial illustration with a restrained monochrome base, soft graphite linework, controlled tonal shading, open paper-white highlights, fine pencil-tooth grain, subtle paper grain, light print-like editorial noise, clean architectural geometry, and restrained corporate-modern calm. Surface should feel like refined graphite on paper: dry, tactile, lightly printed, intentionally unpolished, and never glossy or ultra-smooth. Use a 5:8 vertical composition with generous negative space, sparse layout, and typography-friendly stillness. Keep the image lifted, breathable, and quietly alive rather than dark, gloomy, or noir. Mood: calm, serious, intellectual, institutional, quiet but alert. Avoid cartoon energy, startup clichés, clutter, glossy rendering, logos, text in image, dashboard literalism, and ad-like composition.

conditional_insertions.accent_choice_present: Keep roughly 90-95% of the palette within paper white, bone, soft ash, light slate, iron, charcoal, near-black, and black. Use {accent_choice} for roughly 5-10% of the image as faint reflection, window light, edge tint, or soft atmospheric field.
conditional_insertions.accent_choice_absent: Keep roughly 90-95% of the palette within paper white, bone, soft ash, light slate, iron, charcoal, near-black, and black. Add 5-10% washed accent color using a default mix of mist_blue and warm_parchment, or a single warm_parchment cast if the composition needs more restraint.
conditional_insertions.human_fragment_present: If a human presence appears, treat it as a restrained fragment: silhouette, profile, hands, posture, or seated stillness.
conditional_insertions.human_fragment_absent: Do not force a figure into the scene.
conditional_insertions.brightness_guardrail: Favor paper-lit surfaces, open corridors, soft daylight, pale grounds, and readable separation. Do not let the image collapse into heavy charcoal darkness or depressing mood.

prompt_assembly_template.assembly_note: Omit any conditional sentence when its corresponding input is empty, false, or unspecified.
